title: P1 extension protocol: probabilistic evaluation, cost-aware backtest, tabular baselines, walk-forward, robustness and explainability
decision_record: Recorded before any P1 metric, backtest, feature model, walk-forward run, additional seed or attribution was computed. Stage 2-8 specifications are planned; any change must be appended to amendments with date and reason before the affected stage runs.
study_status: Post-hoc exploratory extension. Labels for the 2024-2025 test period and the Phase 1/2 test accuracies were already observed. P1 results must not be used to revise Phase 1 conclusions, re-select Phase 1 models or tune any P1 model on test data.

data.source_snapshot: Original Yahoo Finance raw files and multi-asset manifest; SHA-256 values in results/summary.json must match before any stage runs.
data.splits: Unchanged label-date split: train 2010-2021, validation 2022-2023, test 2024-2025.
data.post_2025_data: As of this protocol, no 2026 price data have been downloaded or processed by the project pipeline.

models.resnet_pooled: Frozen pooled ResNet-18 checkpoint (freeze.pooled_checkpoint_sha256); score = softmax P(Up); prediction = logit argmax (tie -> Non-up).
models.resnet_spy: Frozen SPY ResNet-18 checkpoint (freeze.spy_checkpoint_sha256); SPY rows only.
models.logreg_closes: Deterministic refit of the fixed post-hoc logistic regression (results/numeric_baseline_protocol.json) on pooled train only; score = predict_proba Up.
models.majority: Pooled training majority class (1) as hard prediction.
models.climatology: Constant probability equal to the pooled training up-ratio; used as the probabilistic counterpart of majority and as the Brier skill reference.
models.trend_20d: Hard 0/1 rule: last input close > first input close. Probability metrics are computed on hard scores and flagged as such.

stage_1_probabilistic_evaluation.reproduction_gate: Regenerated predictions must reproduce every frozen confusion matrix (validation and test, overall and per asset) in results/summary.json and results/numeric_baseline_posthoc.json exactly; otherwise the stage aborts.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap over unique label dates; every asset row on a resampled date is kept to preserve cross-asset dependence.
uncertainty.binomial_test: Exact two-sided binomial test of accuracy against 0.5, reported with the caveat that it assumes independent observations.

stage_1_probabilistic_evaluation.validation_reporting: Validation (2022-2023) point metrics are reported for context; bootstrap intervals are computed for test only.

stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.positions: Long/flat per asset: long 1 unit when prediction = Up, otherwise flat in cash at 0% return. No shorting or leverage. Threshold fixed at 0.5 / model argmax.
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.timing: Decision at close t using information through close t; position earns the close-t to close-(t+1) return (market-on-close execution assumption). Robustness: one-session delayed execution.
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.returns: Asset returns from Adj Close (dividend-inclusive); signals remain based on unadjusted Close inputs.
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.cost_rule: Cost = bps x |position_t - position_(t-1)|, initial entry included.
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.portfolio: Per-asset sleeves plus an equal-weight five-asset portfolio (mean of sleeve daily returns).
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.uncertainty: Same date-block bootstrap for Sharpe and Sharpe difference versus buy-and-hold.
stage_2_cost_aware_backtest.tuning: None. The backtest is an evaluation layer only.

stage_3_tabular_baselines.primary_information_set: Only the same 20 unadjusted closes used by the image model, plus asset identity.
features: realized volatility of 5 and 19 daily log returns
close deviation from 5, 10 and 20 session means
stage_3_tabular_baselines.secondary_information_set: Exploratory extension with OHLC range, volume z-score and 60-session momentum; reported separately and never mixed into primary conclusions.

models.lightgbm: binary objective; num_leaves 15; learning_rate 0.02; n_estimators up to 2000 with early stopping on validation log loss (patience 100); min_child_samples 100; subsample 0.8 with bagging_freq 1; colsample_bytree 0.8; reg_lambda 1.0; seed 42.
models.logreg_features: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0) on the same engineered features.

stage_3_tabular_baselines.selection: Validation used only for early stopping; one test prediction pass.

stage_4_walk_forward.scheme: Expanding window with annual refits. For test year Y in 2014-2025: train on label years 2010 to Y-2, validate on Y-1 (early stopping only), test on Y.
stage_4_walk_forward.resnet_embedding_head: Frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 penultimate 512-d embeddings of the same charts + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0). With a frozen backbone and frozen BatchNorm statistics this is the same model family as the classifier-only ResNet; only the head optimizer differs.
stage_4_walk_forward.reporting: Per-year metrics, pooled out-of-sample metrics and a backtest of concatenated out-of-sample signals. Years 2024-2025 are flagged as previously observed.

stage_5_robustness.resnet: Retrain pooled classifier-only ResNet-18 with the original procedure for each seed (checkpoint by validation loss) and evaluate test once per seed.
stage_5_robustness.lightgbm: Repeat with the same seeds (bagging and column-sampling randomness).
stage_5_robustness.comparisons: Mean, standard deviation and range across seeds; paired date-block bootstrap for pre-specified model differences with Holm correction across the comparison family.

stage_6_explainability_governance.grad_cam: Grad-CAM on layer4 of the pooled ResNet for a fixed selection (most confident Up, most confident Non-up, closest to 0.5) and class-averaged heatmaps; report the share of attribution in the rightmost quarter of the chart.
stage_6_explainability_governance.shap: TreeExplainer on the Stage 3 LightGBM test predictions: global mean |SHAP|, beeswarm and dependence plots for the top features.
stage_6_explainability_governance.model_card: docs/MODEL_CARD.md with model-risk headings: intended use, conceptual soundness, data, outcomes analysis, limitations, ongoing monitoring.

stages.stage_7_integration: Unified results tables, rerun Stage 1-2 evaluation for all new models, README and RUN_LOG update, release with artifacts.
stages.stage_8_optional_fresh_holdout: Optional confirmatory test on 2026 sessions with models frozen beforehand. Requires an amendment that fixes the 2026 session calendar, data cut-off and models before any 2026 data are downloaded.

amendments.change: shap package replaced by LightGBM native TreeSHAP (booster.predict(..., pred_contrib=True)), mathematically identical; avoids numba/numpy-2.4 dependency.
amendments.reason: Keep CI and local environment free of numba/numpy-2.4 incompatibility while producing exact TreeSHAP attributions verified by row-sum additivity.

amendments.change: ResNet seeds are retrained on cached frozen-backbone embeddings (identical forward computation because the backbone and its BatchNorm are frozen and there is no augmentation; the RNG stream differs from the original, so seed 42 is rerun too). Full fine-tune seeds are not repeated (cost); this is listed as a limitation.
amendments.reason: Eliminate redundant 20,120-image forward passes through frozen ImageNet weights across 6 seeds while preserving identical gradient/forward dynamics and testing logits equivalence beforehand.

amendments.change: Pre-registered confirmatory 2026 holdout specification and frozen model hashes prior to downloading any 2026 price data.
amendments.reason: Provide one truly untouched out-of-time confirmatory test after Phase 1/2 and P1 Stages 1-6.
amendments.overlap_check: 2025-10-01..2025-12-31 Close must equal data/raw/{T}.csv within rtol=1e-6 on identical dates.

confirmatory_family.method: Two-sided date-block bootstrap (block 20, B=5000, seed 20261127), Holm-Bonferroni correction at alpha=0.05
